$comment: Single source of truth for Fullmoon i3. Generators emit Tokens.java (mod) and tokens.css (launcher). Never write a colour literal anywhere else; design/verify-tokens.mjs fails the build if you do.

color.$comment: Dark-first, a palace at night: the neutrals are a moonlit indigo and every ink is a warm ivory, so text always reads as lit against the ground. Elevation is carried by lightness, never by shadow — a coloured halo on a dark surface is the shadow-glow tell. Gilt lines are opaque mixes rather than translucent gold, because only a scrim may reopen alpha. The ornament family is decoration and marking (dancheong bands, the seal, the cinnabar diamond on the row the pointer is on) and never means status; live, warning and danger are the status family. Nothing is #000 or #fff.

surface.sunken.use: inset wells, scroll troughs, empty states

surface.raised.use: hovered row, selected list item ground

line.gilt.use: the palace frame's outer line, a tile's edge

line.giltFaint.use: the frame's second line, outside the first

line.lattice.use: window-lattice strokes in a header band

accent.use: corner brackets, selection, one primary action per surface, live values

status.danger.use: destructive only — never a primary action fill

ornament.cinnabar.use: dancheong band, the moon seal's ground

moon.lit.use: the lit face of a moon phase

moon.shadow.use: the unlit face of a moon phase

space.$comment: 4-unit base in GUI-scaled units. Semantic names first; the raw steps exist so a one-off does not become a new literal.

radius.$comment: The palace frame is square: panels, tiles, buttons and fields have no radius. Only what is round in the world is round — dots, knobs, rings, the moon.

type.$comment: Pretendard carries body and UI; a Noto Serif KR instance carries the wordmark, display and heading. One pairing, no third face. Each size is its own baked TTF provider — MC rasterises per provider, so runtime scaling would blur.

motion.$comment: Transform and opacity only. No overshoot on UI state — bounce on a button is the elastic-easing tell. reduceMotion collapses every duration to crossfade.

layer.$comment: Six named levels. An arbitrary z-index is a tell that nobody owned the stacking order.
